# no-duplicate-scenario-names

Disallow duplicate Scenario names within the same Feature or Rule.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | yes | no | none |

Finds case-insensitive duplicate Scenario names within one Feature or one Rule. `{ scope: "anywhere" }` compares across all linted files.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-duplicate-scenario-names": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Rule: Coupon
  Scenario: apply
  Scenario: apply
```
